name: Josiah
title: The Reforming King of Judah
summary: Josiah was king of Judah from the age of eight and reigned for 31 years. He is known as one of the most godly kings in Judah's history, carrying out a comprehensive religious reform after the Book of the Law was found in the temple. He removed idol worship from the land and renewed the covenant with God, but died tragically in battle against Pharaoh Neco at Megiddo.

keyEvents.title: Josiah becomes king at eight years old
keyEvents.description: After his father Amon was murdered, the eight-year-old Josiah was installed as king over Judah.

keyEvents.title: Josiah Begins to Seek God
keyEvents.description: In his eighth year of reign, while he was still young, Josiah began to seek the God of his ancestors, and in his twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of idol worship.

keyEvents.title: Discovery of the Book of the Law in the Temple
keyEvents.description: During the restoration of the temple, the high priest Hilkiah found the Book of the Law. When Josiah heard the words of the law, he tore his clothes in grief over the people's disobedience.

keyEvents.title: The Prophetess Huldah Confirms the Judgment
keyEvents.description: Josiah sent messengers to the prophetess Huldah, who confirmed that God's judgment would come upon Judah, but that Josiah himself would be spared because of his humility.

keyEvents.title: The Great Covenant Renewal and Passover Celebration
keyEvents.description: Josiah gathered all the people and read the Book of the Law to them. He renewed the covenant with the Lord and celebrated the most magnificent Passover since the days of the judges.

keyEvents.title: Josiah's Death at Megiddo
keyEvents.description: Despite warnings, Josiah went out to battle against Pharaoh Neco of Egypt at Megiddo. He was mortally wounded and died, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him, including the prophet Jeremiah.
